events.text: oh no, I think my order is going to my old address. I just moved last week and I only just noticed. Can you help?
I'm sorry about that. I can help you check. First I need to verify your identity. Please send me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure, my full name is Hannah Schultz and my email is hschultz@post.example. I'm really sorry, I should have checked the address before ordering.

Thanks, Hannah, you're verified. There's no need to apologize.

I found your order O-5107 from Saffron Lane. It's already been picked up by the driver and is on its way to 81 Ridge Rd. Our policy only lets me change a delivery address while an order is still being prepared. Once it's picked up, I can't change the address. I also can't cancel it at this stage.

Here's what you can try:
- Contact the restaurant or the driver through the app, if it offers that, and ask whether they can reach you. I can't promise they'll be able to redirect it.
- Ask whoever is at the old address, or the new occupants, to hold the food for you, if that's practical.

If the order is delivered to the old address, I can't offer a refund or credit for it. The policy covers late deliveries and missing or wrong items, and an address mix-up isn't one of those cases.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Oh no, that's really hard to hear. I was really hoping you could redirect it. Is there any way the driver could be reached directly? I don't have a phone number for them, only the app.

I'm sorry, Hannah. I know that's frustrating. I can't contact the driver or give you their number. I don't have a tool for either, and I can't see any driver contact details on the order. The app's order tracking screen is the only way I know of to reach them, and only if it has a message or call option. I can't promise that option is there.

I can also pass your case to a human specialist, who would follow up within 24 hours. They can't change the address either, so that wouldn't get you the food tonight. I also can't say what they would decide. If you'd like that, tell me and I'll set it up.

Is there anything else I can do for you?

Okay, thanks for checking. I don't really want to escalate it if it won't change anything tonight. Could you at least confirm that my order number is 5107 and that the address on it is 81 Ridge Rd, so I know what's going on for sure?

Yes, I can confirm both:

- **Order number:** O-5107 from Saffron Lane
- **Delivery address on the order:** 81 Ridge Rd, Oakdale, CA 94617

The order was picked up at 7:24 PM and is due by 7:40 PM. The address on file as your account default is 6 Willow Lane, Oakdale, CA 94607. That's different from the one on this order. If 6 Willow Lane is your old address, please update your default address in the app before your next order so it doesn't happen again.

Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks for confirming. So the order is O-5107 and it's going to 81 Ridge Rd, which is my old place. That's the one I'm not living at anymore. Wait, you said my account default is 6 Willow Lane, but that's my new address, so I guess the order just picked up the old one from before. I'll update my default in the app right now, thanks for the reminder.

Is there really nothing that can be done about tonight's order? I'm sorry to keep asking, I just feel terrible about this.

Thanks for clearing that up, Hannah. I got it backwards earlier when I guessed that 6 Willow Lane might be your old address. It's your new one, so your account default is already right. The order was placed with your old address, 81 Ridge Rd. You may want to check that address isn't saved separately in the app, so it doesn't get picked again.

I've looked again, and there's nothing I can do for tonight's order. It's been picked up, so I can't change the address or cancel it. I also can't refund or credit it, because an address mix-up isn't covered by our policy. Please don't feel terrible, because this happens a lot after a move.

These are the options that could still help:
- Check the order tracking screen in the app for a way to message or call the driver.
- Ask the current occupants at 81 Ridge Rd to hold the food, if you know them or can reach them.

If you change your mind about a specialist following up, just tell me and I'll set it up. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thank you for checking again. I'll look at the tracking screen and see if there's a message or call option for the driver. I don't know the people at 81 Ridge Rd, so I probably can't ask them to hold it.

I'll also go check whether 81 Ridge Rd is saved as a separate address in the app. Thanks for your help, I know this wasn't the answer I wanted.
